job.description:

1st shift 7AM - 3PM

Monday to Friday 
Pay: $18-$21/hour  (higher pay considered based on experience)
 
Job Description
We are currently hiring 2 experienced Bindery Operators to join a commercial printing and production team!
The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience setting up, operating, adjusting, and troubleshooting industrial paper-folding machines, specifically the Heidelberg Stahlfolder B30 (Stahl B30) or comparable folding equipment.
We are looking for dependable, detail-oriented individuals who understand bindery operations and can independently operate machinery while maintaining production quality and efficiency.

Responsibilities
  • Set up, operate, and troubleshoot Heidelberg Stahlfolder B30 folding machines.
  • Adjust machine settings based on job specifications, paper sizes, and folding requirements.
  • Monitor equipment throughout production to ensure accurate and consistent folding.
  • Identify and resolve machine jams, feeding issues, alignment problems, and other mechanical issues.
  • Perform machine adjustments and basic preventative maintenance.
  • Inspect finished materials to ensure they meet quality standards.
  • Follow production schedules and meet daily productivity goals.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment.
  • Communicate equipment issues and production concerns to supervisors.
  • Assist with additional bindery and production duties as needed.

Requirements
  • Previous experience operating industrial bindery or paper-folding equipment REQUIRED.
  • Experience setting up, running, and troubleshooting a Stahl B30 or comparable industrial folding machine strongly preferred.
  • Ability to independently perform machine setups and adjustments.
  • Knowledge of paper folding, feeding, alignment, and quality control procedures.
  • Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience working in commercial printing, bindery, or print production environments.
  • Ability to read and follow production work orders and job specifications.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to meet production deadlines.
  • Ability to stand for extended periods and perform physical production duties.
  • Reliable attendance and strong work ethic.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with Heidelberg Stahlfolder equipment.
  • Previous experience with Stahl B30 folding machines.
  • Experience operating additional bindery equipment.
  • Familiarity with signature folding and commercial print finishing.
  • Experience performing routine equipment maintenance and mechanical adjustments.

Compensation & Benefits
  • $18.00–$21.00 per hour
  • Higher compensation may be considered for candidates with extensive relevant experience.
  • Full-time employment.
  • Monday through Friday schedule.
  • Day and afternoon/evening shifts available.
  • Long-term employment opportunity.

Apply Today!

If you have experience operating industrial paper-folding equipment and are comfortable independently setting up, running, and troubleshooting machinery, we encourage you to apply!
We are actively interviewing qualified candidates for both shifts.

job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a General Manager  (Non-Destructive Testing) to work at a company located in the Hollywood, FL area!

Job Title:   General Manager – NDT Industry (Non-Destructive Testing)
 
Job Location:  Hollywood, FL 33312 
 
Pay for Job + Benefits 
 
Compensation: $125,000 per year plus yearly bonus incentive

Company Benefits include: 
  • Medical, dental, and vision plans
  • Paid holiday, sick and PTO
  • Paid life insurance
  • 401(K) retirement plan
 
 
Job Description:               
 
                
Duties and Responsibilities:
 
Duties and responsibilities for this role include but are not limited to financial oversight, sales and Business development, customer relationship management, operational management, health and safety, certification, and compliance management. A more detailed overview is listed below.
 
Profit & Loss (P&L) Management:
  • Interpret P&L statements for business insights.
  • Prepare and manage annual budgets, monitor monthly financial performance against budgetary expectations.
 
Sales & Marketing:
  • Direct the company’s sales and marketing strategies.
  • Prepare sales forecasts and set performance objectives.
  • Continuously monitor and analyze market trends and competitor activity.
 
Customer Support:
  • Establish and maintain high customer service standards.
  • Create a feedback mechanism for customer reviews and act upon it for service improvements.
 
Facility and Equipment Maintenance:
  • Ensure facility cleanliness, safety, and perform periodic inspections.
  • Supervise preventive maintenance and repairs to optimize operational efficiency.
 
Employee Training Qualification & Certification:
  • Design, develop, implement, and oversee NDT certification program.
  • Providing Formal Training in various NDT Methods and administering examinations for those methods to employees.
  • Perform periodic employee proficiency reviews and provide feedback.
 
ASNT NDT Level 3 Certification: 
  • Achieve and maintain Level 3 NDT certifications from American Society of Nondestructive Testing (ASNT) in the following methods:
  • MT – Magnetic Particle Testing
  • PT – Penetrant Testing
  • RT – Radiography (X-Ray)
  • ET – Eddy Current Testing
  • UT – Ultrasonic Testing
  • VT – Visual Testing
  • GPR – Ground Penetrating Radar
 
Environment, Health, and Safety (EH&S):
  • Conduct routine safety audits and inspections.
  • Develop or update safety protocols, hazard prevention measures, and emergency response plans.
 
Certifications & Compliance:
  • Maintain accurate records for all quality certifications.
  • Prepare compliance documentation and reports for internal reviews and regulatory submissions.
 
Strategic Management & Leadership:
  • Develop and implement the company’s strategic plan.
  • Lead cross-functional teams to achieve strategic goals and objectives.
 
Reporting:
  • Compile monthly, quarterly, and annual reports on performance metrics, financials, and strategic initiatives.
  • Maintain transparent communication with the parent company.
 
 
Skills and Competencies:
 
Experience:
  1. Minimum of 5 years of managerial experience, with a preference for experience in the NDT or a similar industry.
  2. Bachelor’s degree in business administration or management, engineering, or a related field is strongly preferred.
  3. Leadership and team management skills
  4. Strategic thinking and analytical skills
  5. Excellent written and verbal communication abilities
 
 
Physical Requirements:
Ability to travel to field services and client locations, as needed.

  • Previous experience operating excavators and/or front loaders.

job.title: In-Process Inspector
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Aviation In-Process and Final Inspectors   to work at a company located in the Opa Locka, FL area!

Job Title: Aviation In-Process and Final Inspectors  
 
Job Location: Opa Locka, FL
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:  $25/hr, 1st shift
 
 
Job Description:                                                          
 
We are seeking a detail-oriented Quality Inspector to inspect aircraft components, mechanical assemblies, and parts throughout repair, overhaul, and assembly operations. The ideal candidate will have 2–3 years of quality inspection experience, preferably in aviation, aerospace, manufacturing, or mechanical repair.
Candidates must be able to read technical documentation, identify defects, use precision measuring tools, and maintain accurate inspection records while ensuring compliance with quality standards and applicable FAA requirements.
 
Responsibilities
  • Perform in-process inspections of aircraft components, mechanical assemblies, and parts.
  • Verify workmanship against technical drawings, specifications, work instructions, and approved technical data.
  • Identify defects, damage, dimensional discrepancies, and improper assembly.
  • Use precision measuring instruments, including calipers, micrometers, and gauges.
  • Review work orders and inspection records to ensure all required steps are completed.
  • Verify part numbers, serial numbers, and component traceability documentation.
  • Document inspection results and report nonconforming materials or workmanship.
  • Work with technicians, mechanics, and quality personnel to resolve discrepancies.
  • Verify corrective actions are completed before components move to the next stage of production or repair.
  • Follow company quality procedures, safety standards, and applicable FAA requirements.
Qualifications
  • 2–3 years of experience in quality inspection, mechanical inspection, or a related field.
  • Aviation, aerospace, manufacturing, or mechanical assembly experience preferred.
  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and work instructions.
  • Experience using precision measuring tools such as calipers, micrometers, and gauges.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
  • Basic computer skills for maintaining inspection records.
  • Good communication and problem-solving abilities.
  • High school diploma or GED required.

job.title: Millwright
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Millwright  to work at a company located in the Coral Gables, FL area!

Job Title: Millwright 
 
Job Location: Coral Gables, FL 33146
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: $65K per year
 
Job Description:
The Millwright is responsible for the maintenance, repair, and installation of machinery and equipment across the plant, ensuring the seamless operation of our manufacturing processes. This role supports production, engineering, and quality teams by minimizing equipment downtime and maintaining equipment to FAA, ISO, and customer standards, contributing directly to the quality and efficiency of our products.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities
  1. Perform regular maintenance, inspections, and troubleshooting on machinery and equipment to identify and resolve mechanical issues promptly while minimizing production downtime.
  2. Diagnose and repair defective parts with minimal interruption to production.
  3. Calibrate and test machinery and equipment to ensure accuracy, efficiency, and compliance with quality standards and regulatory requirements.
  4. Participate in the installation, assembly, and setup of machinery and equipment according to specifications and blueprints to ensure proper functionality and alignment with production requirements.
  5. Maintain plant equipment, including but not limited to:
    • Specialized machines in Machine Shop I and II (mills, lathes, etc.)
    • Lasers (in various departments)
    • Chambers and vibration systems in the Environmental Room
    • Conformal coating ovens and UV curing ovens
    • Pick and place systems
    • Solder systems (including wave solder machine)
    • Injection molding machines
    • Auto insertion machines
    • Pneumatic cable machines
    • SMT wash stations
    • RO water system
    • Nitrogen generator system
    • Paint shop ovens
    • ESD maintenance equipment (including bench and floor equipment)
    • Air generator system
  6. Procure and maintain miscellaneous parts and accessories, such as magazines, tools, black boxes, stencils, microscopes, solder stations, UPS units, and respirator cartridges.
  7. Research alternative parts to expedite repairs.
  8. Train staff on the proper use of equipment and machinery to ensure operational efficiency and compliance with established processes and procedures.
  9. Create and document preventive maintenance and troubleshooting processes.
  10. Adhere to safety procedures and protocols when performing maintenance and repair tasks.
  11. Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, repairs, and equipment performance in accordance with FAA and ISO 9000 standards, as well as Boeing and other customer requirements.
  12. Generate reports on maintenance schedules, equipment status, and issues encountered for documentation and analysis.
  13. Act as technical liaison with vendors, and source and order parts required for the maintenance or repair of plant equipment.
Required Qualifications
  1. Associate of Science (A.S.) degree in electronics, or equivalent military or technical trade experience.
  2. Minimum of 5 years of experience as a millwright or equipment technician in a manufacturing environment; avionics industry experience is a plus.
Job Skills Required
  1. Solid understanding of mechanical systems, including hydraulics and pneumatics, as well as electrical systems.
  2. Ability to quickly learn new and continuously changing technologies with minimal training.
  3. Proficient in reading and interpreting drawings, schematics, and technical manuals.
  4. Able to use a variety of software to maintain, repair, and program equipment.
  5. Able to identify and mitigate potential safety hazards related to millwright tasks to ensure a safe working environment.
  6. Strong organizational skills and the ability to support multiple projects while balancing priorities and schedules.
  7. Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineers, production personnel, and management, to optimize equipment performance, troubleshoot complex issues, and implement manufacturing process improvements.
  8. Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word, PowerPoint).
Work Environment
Work is performed primarily on the manufacturing floor and in machine shop areas, with occasional work in outdoor and other environmental conditions. The role involves regular exposure to operating machinery, moderate to high noise levels, and materials such as solder, coatings, and cleaning agents, with appropriate personal protective equipment provided. Flexibility to work occasional overtime, weekends, or off-hours is required to support production schedules and maintenance activities.

Physical Requirements
  • Heavy Work: Exerting up to 100 pounds of force occasionally, up to 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 20 pounds of force constantly to move objects.
  • Standing for most of the workday while performing essential functions.
  • Ability to climb, bend, stoop, kneel, twist, and reach as required to install, maintain, and repair machinery and equipment.
  • Manual dexterity to handle tools, parts, and equipment, including power and precision tools.
  • Visual acuity to read drawings and schematics, inspect parts, and ensure the accuracy and quality of work performed.

Position Summary

 The Shipping Clerk is responsible for preparing and maintaining all shipping documentation for domestic and international customer orders. This role coordinates with carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, customer service, and warehouse personnel to ensure shipments are properly documented, compliant with applicable regulations, and processed accurately and on time.
 
Key Responsibilities
 
  • Prepare and process all domestic and international shipping documentation.
  • Generate bills of lading, packing lists, commercial invoices, certificates of origin, shipper's letters of instruction (SLI), and other export documents as required.
  • Create shipping paperwork and labels for customer orders using ERP and carrier systems.
  • Ensure export documentation complies with customs, regulatory, and customer requirements.
  • Coordinate with freight forwarders, customs brokers, and transportation providers regarding shipment documentation and export procedures.
  • Review orders for accuracy and verify shipping information, customer requirements, and routing instructions.
  • Maintain shipping records and documentation in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Track shipments and provide shipment status updates to internal stakeholders and customers as needed.
  • Resolve documentation discrepancies, shipping issues, and customs-related inquiries.
  • Assist with maintaining Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) codes, country of origin information, and other trade compliance data.
  • Support audits and compliance reviews related to domestic and international shipping activities.
  • Collaborate with customer service, warehouse, manufacturing, and logistics teams to ensure timely order fulfillment.
 
Qualifications
 
  • High school diploma or GED required; associate degree preferred.
  • 2+ years of shipping, logistics, export documentation, or customer service experience preferred.
  • Experience preparing international shipping and export documentation.
  • Knowledge of international shipping procedures, customs documentation, Incoterms®, and freight transportation methods.
  • Proficiency with ERP systems, shipping software, and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.
 
Preferred Qualifications
 
  • Experience working with freight forwarders and customs brokers.
  • Knowledge of export compliance regulations and international trade documentation.
  • Experience with SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, or similar ERP systems.
  • Familiarity with HTS classifications, AES filings, and letters of credit.

Job Description: 
Temp-to-Hire | Monday–Friday | 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
Our client is seeking a dependable, detail-oriented Aviation Stockroom Clerk to support daily operations by maintaining inventory accuracy and ensuring aerospace parts, components, tools, and supplies are properly stored and readily available to technicians and authorized personnel.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone with stockroom, inventory, warehouse, or aviation parts experience looking for a long-term position.

Key Responsibilities
  • Maintain an organized stockroom, ensuring parts, components, tools, and supplies are stored in designated locations.
  • Issue aerospace parts, materials, tools, and supplies to technicians and authorized personnel.
  • Accurately record inventory transactions, including items issued, returned, transferred, and received.

  • Verify part numbers, descriptions, quantities, and serial numbers when applicable.

  • Coordinate with technicians, repair personnel, purchasing, receiving, and quality departments.
  • Maintain clean, safe, and organized stockroom shelves, bins, and work areas.
  • Follow established safety procedures and requirements for handling and storing aviation components.
  • Locate hard-to-find parts and materials to minimize delays in repair operations.
  • Perform additional stockroom and inventory duties as assigned.

Qualifications & Requirements
  • High school diploma or GED preferred.
  • Previous experience as a Stockroom Clerk, Inventory Clerk, Warehouse Associate, Material Handler, or Parts Clerk preferred.
  • Aerospace, aviation, manufacturing, or Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul (MRO) experience is a plus.
  • Basic computer skills and the ability to accurately enter and retrieve inventory information.
  • Strong attention to detail when reviewing part numbers, quantities, and inventory records.
  • Ability to follow written and verbal instructions and established procedures.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with multiple departments.
  • Dependable, punctual, and committed to inventory accuracy.
  • Effective communication and teamwork skills.

  • Hours: 8:00 AM–5:00 PM
  • Employment Type: Temporary to Hire
  • Industry: Aviation

Duties and Responsibilities:
 
Duties and responsibilities for this role include but are not limited to financial oversight, sales and Business development, customer relationship management, operational management, health and safety, certification, and compliance management. A more detailed overview is listed below.
 
Profit & Loss (P&L) Management:

Sales & Marketing:

Customer Support:

Employee Training Qualification & Certification:

ASNT NDT Level 3 Certification:

• MT – Magnetic Particle Testing
• PT – Penetrant Testing
• RT – Radiography (X-Ray)

• UT – Ultrasonic Testing

job.title: Double Pallet Jack Operator
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Double Pallet Jack Operator to work at a company located in the Lowell, AR area!

Job Title: Double Pallet Jack Operator
 
Job Location: Lowell, AR
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:  $18-$20 per hour
 
Job Description:                                                          
 
Position Summary

 The Double Pallet Jack Operator safely operates an electric end-rider double pallet jack to transport, stage, load, and unload palletized products throughout a temperature-controlled food distribution center. Working primarily in cooler and freezer environments ranging from 34 degrees F to -10 degrees F, this role requires rapid, high-accuracy order selection and material movement while adhering strictly to OSHA regulations and food safety standards.
 
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
 
  • Equipment Operation: Safely operate a motorized electric double pallet jack to transport product loads efficiently across dock and freezer floors.
  • Receiving & Staging: Unload inbound shipments, verify load stability, and transport incoming goods to specified cold storage locations or staging lanes.
  • Order Selection & Loading: Accurately pick full-pallet quantities using automated systems (RF scanners or Voice-to-Pick), ensuring proper weight distribution before loading outbound trailers.
  • Pre-Shift Inspections: Perform mandatory daily pre-operation safety checks on assigned equipment (brakes, steering, controls, battery status) and document findings per regulatory standards.
  • Cold-Chain Integrity: Execute tasks efficiently to ensure product exposure to ambient temperatures is minimized, strictly preserving the cold chain.
  • Chemical & Safety: Maintain a clean work environment by removing shrink wrap, damaged pallets, and debris from walkways. Comply with all standard warehouse safety guidelines and immediately report any product damages or equipment malfunctions.
 
Required Qualifications & Competencies
 
  • Experience: Minimum of 1 year of experience operating a powered industrial truck, specifically a motorized electric rider pallet jack, in a fast-paced environment.
  • Licensing & Certification: Must possess or be able to successfully pass the employer-administered OSHA Class III Powered Industrial Truck Certification within the first week of employment.
  • Technical Skills: Experience using warehouse management systems (WMS) and RF scanning barcode devices.
  • Mathematical Competency: Ability to read numbers, perform basic addition and subtraction, and visually confirm accuracy on inventory pick sheets.
 
Physical Demands & Work Environment
 
  • Temperature Extremes: Constant exposure to sub-freezing temperatures (34 degrees F down to -10 degrees F). Proper thermal personal protective equipment (PPE) will be provided.
  • Physical Stamina: Ability to stand and ride on the equipment platform for extended periods throughout an 8- to 10-hour shift.
  • Heavy Lifting: Ability to frequently lift, push, pull, or carry objects weighting up to 60 lbs without assistance to restack or secure shifted loads.
  • Agility: Frequent bending, crouching, reaching, and twisting while managing loads and navigating tight warehouse aisles.

job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Maintenance Technician/Mechanic  to work at a company located in the Miramar, FL area!

Job Location: Miramar

Técnico de Mantenimiento / Mecánico Industrial
 Horario: lunes a viernes (6:00AM a 2:30PM)
 Pago: $24 - $26 según experiencia.
 
Resumen del puesto
Estamos buscando un Técnico de Mantenimiento / Mecánico Industrial con experiencia para realizar mantenimiento preventivo, diagnosticar fallas, reparar maquinaria y ajustar equipos en un entorno de manufactura y empaque farmacéutico.
El candidato ideal debe tener experiencia práctica en sistemas eléctricos, mecánicos y neumáticos, así como conocimientos de soldadura, aire acondicionado (HVAC), compresores y sistemas PLC. Esta posición es fundamental para garantizar el buen funcionamiento de los equipos, reducir los tiempos de inactividad y mantener un ambiente de trabajo seguro y eficiente.
 
Responsabilidades principales
  • Realizar inspecciones, diagnosticar problemas y ejecutar reparaciones y mantenimiento general en la planta.
  • Investigar especificaciones técnicas e información de los equipos para determinar los procedimientos de reparación adecuados.
  • Diagnosticar fallas mecánicas y realizar reparaciones y ajustes en maquinaria de producción.
  • Lubricar y dar mantenimiento a los equipos de la planta para garantizar su funcionamiento óptimo.
  • Realizar pruebas de funcionamiento después de las reparaciones para verificar que los equipos operen correctamente.
  • Identificar y seleccionar materiales y piezas de reemplazo según los requerimientos mecánicos.
  • Ajustar y calibrar componentes de las máquinas.
  • Instalar, ensamblar y probar maquinaria y equipos nuevos.
  • Inspeccionar visualmente los equipos para identificar desgaste, daños, fallas o posibles averías.
  • Realizar reparaciones de sistemas eléctricos, mecánicos y neumáticos, así como trabajos de soldadura y mantenimiento de sistemas HVAC y compresores.
  • Aplicar conocimientos de PLC (controladores lógicos programables) para diagnosticar problemas y realizar mantenimiento de equipos.
  • Cumplir con las Buenas Prácticas de Manufactura (GMP), los procedimientos de seguridad, las normas de higiene y los requisitos de limpieza y organización.
  • Mantener las áreas de trabajo limpias, seguras y organizadas.
 
Requisitos mínimos
  • Diploma de escuela secundaria (High School Diploma) o título técnico de, al menos dos años.
  • Mínimo de 5 años de experiencia en mantenimiento dentro de entornos de manufactura y empaque farmacéutico.
  • Experiencia práctica y capacitación en reparación de equipos eléctricos, mecánicos y neumáticos, así como soldadura, aire acondicionado (HVAC) y compresores.
  • Conocimientos prácticos de sistemas PLC.
  • Disponibilidad para trabajar turnos nocturnos y fines de semana.
  • Capacidad para trabajar eficazmente con personas de diferentes orígenes y equipos de trabajo diversos.
  • Se prefiere dominio del inglés y español.
 
Ambiente y horario de trabajo
  • Trabajo presencial en una planta de manufactura y empaque.
  • Disponibilidad para trabajar noches y fines de semana, según las necesidades de producción.
  • Posición práctica que requiere inspeccionar, diagnosticar, reparar y dar mantenimiento a maquinaria industrial.
 
 
Perfil del candidato ideal
Buscamos una persona responsable, proactiva y con sólidos conocimientos técnicos en mantenimiento industrial, capaz de identificar y resolver problemas mecánicos y eléctricos, mantener los equipos en óptimas condiciones y cumplir con los estándares de seguridad y calidad de la industria farmacéutica.

Employees support the processing, inspection, and packaging of poultry products. Duties vary by department and may include:
 
Handling, sorting, and moving poultry products along the production line.

Follow plant restrictions on jewelry, watches, piercings, artificial nails, nail polish, and personal items including cell phones in production areas.
No sleeveless shirts, shorts - clothes must be clean and cannot have holes. Jeans cannot be torn, ripped, or frayed. 
Hygiene standards must be upheld.

job.title: Wastewater Treatment Technician
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Wastewater Treatment Technician to work at a company located in the Fort Wayne, IN area!

Job Title:    Wastewater Treatment Technician
 
Job Location:  Fort Wayne
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:  $19-$26 p/hr DOE 6am-4pm or 4pm-2am Mon-Thur.
 
Job Description:          
 
Key Responsibilities
 
Wastewater Treatment
•           Operate and monitor wastewater treatment equipment (clarifiers, filter presses, ion exchange, reverse osmosis, chemical feed systems, etc.)
•           Perform chemical treatment processes such as pH neutralization, metals precipitation, and chelation breaking for plating/finishing rinse waters
•           Collect and test water samples for pH, metals concentration (e.g., chromium, nickel, copper, zinc, cadmium), and other regulated parameters
•           Maintain accurate logs of chemical usage, flow rates, and lab results for regulatory compliance (EPA, local POTW permits)
•           Perform preventive maintenance and minor repairs on pumps, valves, tanks, and dosing systems
•           Manage handling, storage, and proper disposal of hazardous waste sludge (filter cake) in accordance with RCRA requirements
•           Order and manage inventory of treatment chemicals
•           Troubleshoot process upsets and adjust treatment parameters as needed
 
RoHS Compliance Support
•           Monitor use of RoHS-restricted substances in plating baths and processes, including lead, cadmium, hexavalent chromium, mercury, and certain brominated flame retardants/phthalates where applicable
•           Track substitution of restricted materials with RoHS-compliant alternatives (e.g., trivalent chromium in place of hexavalent chromium plating solutions)
•           Maintain documentation and traceability records supporting customer RoHS compliance declarations and Certificates of Conformance
•           Coordinate with quality/engineering teams on material composition testing (e.g., XRF screening) to verify plated parts meet RoHS threshold limits
•           Assist in maintaining Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and chemical inventory records reflecting RoHS status of process chemicals
•           Support internal and customer audits related to RoHS and REACH compliance
•           Stay current on updates to RoHS Directive (2011/65/EU and amendments) and related restricted substance regulations
 
 
General Compliance & Safety
•           Assist in preparing reports for regulatory agencies (e.g., discharge monitoring reports)
•           Follow all safety protocols when handling acids, caustics, and heavy metal-bearing solutions (PPE, spill response, SDS compliance)
•           Support broader environmental compliance initiatives (RCRA, REACH, Prop 65 as applicable)
•           Must be able to operate a forklift safely 
 
 
Qualifications
•           High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree in environmental science, chemistry, or related field preferred
•           1–3+ years of experience in industrial wastewater treatment, plating operations, or a related field preferred
•           Working knowledge of pretreatment regulations and metal finishing discharge limits
•           Familiarity with RoHS/REACH restricted substance requirements strongly preferred
•           Basic chemistry skills and ability to perform lab titrations/tests
•           Mechanical aptitude for pump/valve maintenance
•           Ability to lift 50 lbs, work around chemicals, and wear required PPE
•           Wastewater certification (state-specific) a plus
 
 
Work Environment
•           Industrial plant setting with exposure to chemicals, fumes, and wet/humid conditions
•           May require rotating shifts, weekend, or on-call availability

job.title: Chemical Laboratory Technician
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Chemical Laboratory Technician to work at a company located in the Fort Wayne, IN area!

Job Title:    Chemical Laboratory Technician
 
Job Location:  Fort Wayne
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:  $18-$29 p/hr DOE 6am-4pm or 4pm-2am Mon-Thur.
 
Job Description:          
 
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
 
Laboratory Testing
●          Collect and prepare samples from plating lines, process tanks, and finished parts according to established sampling schedules and procedures.
●          Perform routine chemical analysis (titration, spectrophotometry, pH/conductivity testing, and similar methods) on plating bath chemistries and process solutions.
●          Record test results accurately and promptly in laboratory logs or laboratory information systems.
●          Flag out-of-specification results to the Chemical Laboratory Manager and assist with follow-up testing as needed.
●          Assist with sample analysis supporting wastewater treatment monitoring, as directed by the Chemical Laboratory Manager.
●          Maintain, clean, and perform basic upkeep of laboratory equipment and testing instruments; report equipment issues promptly.
Quality Support
●          Support inspection of finished parts for plating quality characteristics (e.g., thickness, adhesion, appearance) as directed.
●          Assist in documenting and investigating quality issues or customer complaints related to plating chemistry, under the guidance of the Chemical Laboratory Manager.
●          Help maintain organized, accurate laboratory records to support internal and customer quality audits.
●          Follow established quality control procedures and checklists consistently for all testing activities.
Safety and Housekeeping
●          Follow all laboratory safety procedures, including proper handling, labeling, and storage of laboratory chemicals.
●          Maintain a clean, organized, and safe laboratory work area.
●          Properly dispose of laboratory waste and chemicals in accordance with company procedures and environmental regulations.
●          Report safety concerns, spills, or near-misses to the Chemical Laboratory Manager immediately.
 
This position has no supervisory responsibility. The Chemical Laboratory Technician works under the direct supervision of the Chemical Laboratory Manager.
 
Qualifications
 
Education and Experience
 
●          High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate's degree or coursework in chemistry, laboratory science, or a related field preferred.
●          1-3 years of laboratory experience preferred; experience in a plating, metal finishing, or industrial laboratory setting is a plus.
●          On-the-job training will be provided for plating-specific testing methods and procedures.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
●          Basic understanding of chemistry and laboratory testing principles.
●          Ability to follow detailed testing procedures accurately and consistently.
●          Strong attention to detail and good recordkeeping habits.
●          Basic math skills, including the ability to perform calculations related to titration and solution concentrations.
●          Ability to work safely with laboratory and process chemicals.
●          Basic computer skills for data entry and recordkeeping.
●          Good communication skills for reporting results and flagging issues to the Laboratory Manager.
 
Physical Requirements
 
Ability to stand and work at lab benches for extended periods; ability to lift up to 25 lbs; ability to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE), including gloves, eye protection, and lab coats; occasional exposure to laboratory and process chemicals.
 
Work Environment
 
Work is performed primarily in the on-site chemical laboratory, with regular time on the production floor to collect samples. Exposure to laboratory chemicals, plating solutions, and related odors is expected; appropriate PPE and safety protocols must be followed at all times.

job.title: Food Safety & Quality Manager
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Food Safety & Quality Manager  to work at a company located in the Doral, FL area!

Job Title: Food Safety & Quality Manager 
Job Location:   Doral 
Pay and Hours Temp to Hire   Salary Range / Rate: $85K – $105K 
 
Position Summary
The Food Safety & Quality Manager will be responsible for overseeing and maintaining all food safety, quality assurance, and regulatory compliance programs within the salmon processing facility. This position will ensure that products are manufactured, handled, stored, and shipped in accordance with company standards, customer specifications, FDA/USDA requirements, HACCP guidelines, and applicable seafood industry regulations.
The ideal candidate will have strong leadership skills, hands-on experience in food manufacturing or seafood processing, and a solid understanding of HACCP, GMPs, sanitation, quality systems, and regulatory compliance.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Manage and oversee the plant’s Food Safety and Quality Assurance programs.
  • Develop, implement, and maintain HACCP plans and prerequisite programs.
  • Ensure compliance with FDA, USDA, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor production processes to ensure food safety and product quality standards are consistently met.
  • Conduct regular inspections of production areas, equipment, products, and processes.
  • Oversee environmental monitoring, sanitation verification, allergen control, and microbiological testing programs.
  • Review and maintain food safety and quality documentation, records, and reports.
  • Investigate product quality issues, customer complaints, non-conformances, and food safety incidents.
  • Lead root-cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA).
  • Work closely with Production, Sanitation, Maintenance, Warehouse, and Operations teams to identify and resolve quality and food safety concerns.
  • Establish and monitor quality specifications for raw materials, work-in-process, and finished products.
  • Verify temperature controls throughout receiving, processing, storage, and shipping.
  • Ensure proper handling and storage of salmon and other seafood products to maintain product integrity and food safety.
  • Conduct internal audits and coordinate customer, third-party, and regulatory audits.
  • Maintain relationships and communication with regulatory agencies, customers, laboratories, and third-party auditors as needed.
  • Train and coach employees on GMPs, HACCP, food safety, sanitation, personal hygiene, and quality procedures.
  • Maintain current knowledge of food safety regulations, seafood industry standards, and customer requirements.
  • Review production and quality data to identify trends and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Ensure timely completion and accuracy of all food safety and quality records.

job.title: Maintenance Technician (2nd & 3rd Shift) - Bedford Park, IL
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Maintenance Technician (2nd & 3rd Shift)  to work at a manufacturing company located in the Bedford Park, IL area!

Job Title: Maintenance Technician (2nd and 3rd Shift) 
 
Job Location: Bedford Park, IL 60638
  
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:   
 
Pay: $30-$35 per hour depending on experience 
 
Company Benefits:             
 
  • Healthcare coverage including medical, dental and vision
  • 401k Plan
  • Short-term disability available
  • Paid holidays, vacation and paid sick leave 
 
Job Description:     
 
About the Role

Join our client's maintenance team in a clean, climate-controlled manufacturing facility. Their facility operation features modern, standardized equipment, with much of their machinery less than five years old, helping streamline troubleshooting and maintenance activities. They utilize a fully digital CMMS to support efficient maintenance planning, minimize downtime, and maintain high operational standards. 
 
The Maintenance Technician is responsible for ensuring the efficient operation and maintenance of machinery and mechanical equipment in the production facility. This role focuses on minimizing downtime, maintaining quality standards, and supporting the production team by performing timely repairs, adjustments, and preventive maintenance.

  Key Responsibilities:
 
  • Perform setup, repair, and maintenance of production machinery, including ovens, packing lines, and conveyors, ensuring optimal performance and minimal downtime.
  • Conduct routine inspections and preventive maintenance to identify potential issues before they impact production.
  • Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic systems to resolve equipment malfunctions quickly and effectively.
  • Repair and maintain plumbing systems, hydraulic components, and cutting tools to support facility operations.
  • Operate and maintain power tools and industrial equipment safely, adhering to all safety protocols.
  • Perform welding tasks (MIG, TIG, Stick) to repair or fabricate machine components as needed.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) systems and electrical issues to maintain automation systems.
  • Document maintenance activities, including repairs and inspections, ensuring accurate records for compliance and future reference.
  • Collaborate with the production team to minimize disruptions and improve operational efficiency.
  • Support changeovers by preparing and adjusting equipment to meet production requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices), safety protocols, and food industry regulations.  
 
Qualifications:
 
  • High school diploma or equivalent; technical certification or degree is a plus.
  • 2-5 years of experience in an industrial bakery and/or food manufacturing environment preferred.
  • Strong mechanical and troubleshooting skills with a service-oriented mindset.
  • Experience with equipment maintenance, including conveyors, pneumatic systems, and hydraulics. Power Industrial Training Certification is a plus. Proficiency in electrical systems and PLC diagnostics is highly desirable.
  • Welding experience (MIG, TIG, Stick) is a significant advantage. Must be a self-starter capable of working independently and completing projects without supervision. Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in a team environment.
 
                                                
Sponsorship for work authorization is not available for this position. It is the candidate’s responsibility to ensure they are legally authorized to work in the location to which they apply.

job.description:

Job Title: Assistant Food Safety and Quality Assurance Manager  
 
Job Location: Alma, GA
 
Salary: $65k to $90k depending on experience 
 
Shift: 6am to 3pm
 
Bilingual – English/Spanish Preferred
 

Job Description: 
 
  • ****Must have five years of experience in the food industry
  • Serve as the designated liaison between the plant and FSIS; keep current with USDA/FSIS regulations and ensure compliance with requirements related to plant conditions, Sanitation Standard Operating Procedures, HACCP, GMPs, labeling, microbiology, allergen control, and prerequisite programs.
  • Assist in writing, implementing, verifying, and maintaining food safety and quality procedures and programs to produce safe food with acceptable quality attributes, including documentation, document control, and record retention.
  • Oversee BRC implementation and management, including food safety fundamentals,
  • HACCP-based food safety plans, food quality plans, verification activities, internal audits, and external supplier audits as needed.
  • Investigate customer complaints, determine appropriate corrective and preventive actions, and ensure complaint responses and documentation are completed.
  • Maintain and verify the pest control program, including monitoring contracted service reports, open conditions, program effectiveness, and required records.
  • Maintain product traceability for ingredients, supplies, raw materials, packaging, and finished products, including supplier database activities and records to support recall or recovery events.
  • Maintain the written recall program and test its effectiveness through mock recalls.
  • Provide and coordinate food safety and quality training for management, employees, and team members, including HACCP and other applicable food safety training required by the training program.
  • Maintain and verify the Food Defense Program to ensure it remains current and properly implemented.
  • Review FSIS export library requirements and ensure required export procedures and documentation are followed when product is exported.
  • Oversee laboratory functions, scientific testing, environmental programs for raw and cooked facilities, and corrective or preventive actions based on results.
  • Ensure food safety and quality requirements are considered during new product development and that regulatory compliance is maintained.
  • Conduct yield tests, maintain related data, and report results as required.
  • Maintain Sanitation Programs and related sanitation support activities assigned to the Food Safety and Quality Assurance function.
  • Develop and update food safety manuals, SOPs, and program documents as needed for new programs or changes to existing programs.
  • Conduct validations of CCPs and intervention systems and implement corrective actions for food safety deficiencies as needed.
  • Maintain food safety files and records, returned goods and hold logs, foreign object investigation logs, and other required compliance records
 
Supervisory Responsibilities               
Directly supervises employees in the Food Safety and Quality Assurance Department, including Quality Assurance Supervisors, QA and HACCP Assistant, Quality Assurance Technicians, and other assigned personnel. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization's policies and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; addressing complaints and resolving problems.
 
Computer Skills
Must have proficient computer skills and an understanding of Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point, and Access as well as experience in labeling software for development (Label Matrix, Byzerba, or similar) and for label approval (EZ Form or similar).
 
Certificates, Licenses, Registrations  
• HACCP certified   
• Food Safety and Handling certifications.
 
 
Education: 
Minimum Bachelor of Science degree in Food Science, Biology, Chemistry, Meat Science, Microbiology, or a related field. OR a minimum of five years of experience in the food industry with knowledge of the responsibilities listed in this job description.

job.title: Controls Technician - 1st Shift
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Controls Maintenance Technician- 1st Shift  to work at a company located in the Des Plains, IL area!

Job Title: Controls Technician- 1st Shift 
 
Job Location: Des Plaines, IL 60018
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:   
 
Pay: $46.00 - $57.50 per hour depending on experience 
 
 
Company Benefits: 
 
• health/dental/vision insurance
• flex spending accounts
• short & long-term disability
• paid holidays and vacation
• bonus opportunities (referral, production, etc.).
 
 
Job Description:       
 
Food manufacturing company in Des Plaines, IL is looking for a 1st Shift Controls Maint. Technician. 
 
Summary of role:
This position will be responsible for development, testing and implementation of all programming and electrical controls. This would include all programmable controller platforms, graphical user interface platforms, gateways, AC/DC electrical schematic development and debugging as well as training personnel on these systems both operationally and technically. This position is key to the company as most of the systems in place currently need to be upgraded and there are many missing electrical schematics this position could help to develop for troubleshooting purposes.
 
 
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:
 
Duties may include, but are not limited to the following:
  • Electrical System project management.
  • Electrical/Programming troubleshooting.
  • Electrical/Programming training of technicians.
  • Manage inventory of print library/archive and backups for all machines.
 
 
Qualifications:
 
  • Electrical System knowledge and experience to include VFD(s), Servos, high and low voltage troubleshooting.
  • Ability and experience troubleshooting and modifying Electrical/PLC-GUI Programming/Controls
  • Ability to use laptop to troubleshoot a PLC problem.
  • Ability to use laptop to point a Maintenance Technician to a machine problem.
  • Ability to troubleshoot scale, x-ray, and checkweigher problems.
  • Ability to resolve VFD, Servo, safety module or miscellaneous drive faults.
  • Ability to make PLC program modifications and tuning adjustments (timers, fault capture)
  • Possess a basic understanding of PID loops.
  • AutoCAD electrical schematic one-line drawing development preferred but not required.
  • AutoCAD mechanical drawing development preferred but not required.
  • NFPA 70E Arc Flash safety certification is a plus.
  • Communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.
  • Ability to read and write in English.
                                                
Sponsorship for work authorization is not available for this position. It is the candidate’s responsibility to ensure they are legally authorized to work in the location to which they apply.

job.title: CNC Machinist Grade 2
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a  CNC Machinist-Grade 2   1st and 2nd shift to work at a company located in the Fort Wayne, IN area!

Job Title:    CNC Machinist-Grade 2   1st and 2nd shift
 
Job Location:  Fort Wayne
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:  $22-$28 p/hr   
6AM – 2PM (Mon-Fri) 10AM – 8PM (Mon-Thurs)
 
Job Description:          
 
The CNC Machinist (Grade 2) is responsible for independently producing precision machined parts by setting up, programming, and operating CNC equipment with minimal supervision. This role requires strong technical competency in machining practices, program editing and creation, tooling selection, and quality verification. The Grade 2 machinist supports manufacturing operations by ensuring efficient setups, maintaining process accuracy, troubleshooting issues, and consistently meeting quality and productivity standards.
 
Key Responsibilities:
• Read, interpret, and follow work orders, blueprints, engineering drawings, and specifications.
• Measure and verify part dimensions using comparators, calipers, micrometers, bore gages, height gages, indicators, and other precision  tools.
• Independently set up, operate, and monitor CNC machines within the assigned department.
• Write, edit, and optimize CNC programs, including G-code modifications and basic programming logic.
• Select, install, and adjust proper workholding such as collets, chucks, fixtures, and vises.
• Set up, preset, and change tooling as required for each job, ensuring proper offsets and tool life management.
• Inspect first-run and in-process parts to maintain quality standards and make necessary adjustments.
• Operate equipment unsupervised while maintaining consistent output and adherence to specifications.
• Troubleshoot machining issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective actions.
• Meet or exceed standard productivity requirements and follow established manufacturing processes.
• Accurately report time, materials, and job progress in manufacturing systems.
• Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work area.
• Perform routine equipment checks, basic maintenance, and communicate repair needs.
• Support continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to process enhancements.
• Perform other duties as assigned.
 
Preferred Skills:
• Proficiency in safely operating CNC and manual shop equipment.
• Strong mechanical aptitude and understanding of machining principles.
• 2+ years of machining or manufacturing experience.
• Ability to operate manual machines (lathe, mill, grinder).
• Working knowledge of CNC controls, instrumentation, and machining processes.
• Ability to write, edit, and troubleshoot CNC programs.
• Strong computer skills, including Excel, Word, and ERP systems.
• Excellent functional and technical skills with strong attention to detail.
• Clear verbal communication and documentation abilities.
• Ability to follow instructions, ask questions when needed, and learn new processes quickly.
 
Personal Attributes:
• Dependable and punctual, with consistent attendance.
• Able to work independently with minimal supervision or collaboratively as part of a team.
• Strong problem-solving mindset with sound judgment.
• Quality-focused with a commitment to continuous improvement.
• Self-motivated, adaptable, and eager to grow within the CNC machining trade.
 
Physical Demands:
• Prolonged standing throughout the shift.
• Occasional stooping, kneeling, or crouching.
• Regularly lift and move up to 50 lbs.
• Frequent exposure to grease, oils, noise, and coolant in a manufacturing environment.

job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a HVAC Warehouse Manager  to work at a company located in the Pompano, FL area!

Job Title: HVAC Warehouse Manager 
 
Job Location: Pompano  
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: M-F $60-65k Direct hire, health vision dental 401k PTO, paid holidays 
 
Job Description:          
We are seeking an experienced and highly organized HVAC Warehouse Manager to oversee daily warehouse operations at our Pompano Beach location. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in warehouse management, inventory control, shipping and receiving, and team leadership, preferably within the HVAC, construction, plumbing, electrical, or distribution industries.
This individual will be responsible for maintaining accurate inventory levels, ensuring timely order fulfillment, supervising warehouse personnel, and supporting the efficient distribution of equipment, parts, and supplies to customers, service technicians, and installation teams.

Key Responsibilities
  • Oversee daily warehouse operations, including receiving, stocking, picking, packing, shipping, and order fulfillment.
  • Manage inventory of HVAC equipment, parts, materials, and supplies.
  • Maintain accurate inventory records and conduct regular cycle counts and physical inventories.
  • Coordinate the timely receipt and distribution of materials to service technicians, installers, and customers.
  • Supervise, train, schedule, and evaluate warehouse personnel.
  • Monitor inventory levels and coordinate with purchasing to maintain adequate stock.
  • Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies, damaged goods, and shipping errors.
  • Ensure warehouse operations comply with company policies, OSHA regulations, and workplace safety standards.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, safe, and efficient warehouse environment.
  • Coordinate deliveries and transportation logistics with vendors and customers.
  • Oversee the safe operation of forklifts and other warehouse equipment.
  • Identify opportunities to improve warehouse processes, increase productivity, and reduce operational costs.
  • Collaborate with purchasing, sales, operations, and accounting departments.
  • Prepare reports related to inventory accuracy, warehouse productivity, and operational performance.

Qualifications
  • Minimum of 3–5 years of warehouse management or supervisory experience.
  • Experience in HVAC distribution, construction materials, plumbing, electrical supply, or a related distribution industry preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of warehouse operations, inventory control, shipping, receiving, and order fulfillment.
  • Experience managing warehouse employees, including scheduling, training, and performance management.
  • Familiarity with warehouse management systems (WMS) and inventory tracking software.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
  • Forklift operation experience and certification preferred.
  • Knowledge of OSHA regulations and warehouse safety procedures.
  • Strong leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and work in a fast-paced warehouse environment.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish preferred.
  • High school diploma or GED required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred.

Physical Requirements
  • Ability to lift and move up to 50 pounds regularly.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, and climb throughout the workday.
  • Comfortable working in warehouse environments with varying temperatures.
  • Ability to safely operate warehouse equipment.

Compensation & Benefits
  • Annual Salary: $60,000–$65,000, depending on experience and qualifications.
  • Direct-hire opportunity.
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance.
  • 401(k) retirement plan.
  • Paid time off and holidays.
  • Opportunity to lead warehouse operations and contribute to process improvements.

job.title: PCB Designer-Level II
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a PCP Designer – Level II to work at a company located in the Coral Gables, FL area!

Job Title: PCP Designer – Level II

Job Location: Coral Gables 
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: $80K

Job Description
The PCB Designer (Mid-Level) is responsible for the design and layout of complex printed circuit boards for avionics systems, operating with a high degree of independence. This role applies strong knowledge of signal integrity, electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), and electrostatic discharge (ESD) principles to develop reliable, high-quality designs. The PCB Designer implements advanced design constraints, including differential pair routing, impedance control, and trace length matching, and plays a key role in supporting system integration through cross-functional collaboration. Utilizing industry-standard ECAD tools, this role contributes to design strategy, identifies opportunities for process improvement, and helps drive quality and efficiency across the PCB development lifecycle.

 PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
 • Design and develop complex, multi-layer PCB layouts for avionics systems, including high-speed digital, analog, RF, and power circuits.
 • Apply advanced signal integrity and power integrity constraints, including differential pair routing, impedance control, controlled trace lengths, and propagation delay considerations.
 • Develop and maintain electrical schematics of moderate complexity, ensuring proper component selection, connectivity, and alignment with layout and system requirements.
 • Ensure compliance with EMC/EMI and ESD protection standards throughout the design lifecycle.
 • Prepare and release complete fabrication and assembly documentation packages, including Gerbers, ODB++, drill files, drawings, and bills of materials (BOMs).
 • Collaborate cross-functionally with electrical, mechanical, and manufacturing engineering teams to support optimal design solutions and successful system integration.
 • Participate in and contribute to design reviews, including engineering, DFM, and DFA evaluations, incorporating feedback into designs.
 • Support prototyping, debugging, and design iterations based on test results and production feedback.
 • Maintain and enhance PCB libraries, components, and design templates within the CAD/Altium environment.
 • Ensure adherence to aerospace standards, internal processes, and configuration control requirements.
 • Interface with manufacturing teams, including SMT production, to support builds and help resolve design-related issues.
 • Perform root cause analysis for PCB-related issues and contribute to corrective actions.
 • Provide input on layout effort, timelines, and design complexity during project planning.
 • Support knowledge sharing and contribute to team best practices.
 • Engage with internal stakeholders on design considerations to ensure alignment with program requirements.
 • Identify opportunities for process improvements and contribute to continuous improvement efforts.
 
QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
 • Associate degree, PCB Design technical certification, or equivalent experience in electronics or circuit design.
 • Minimum 4 years of experience in PCB layout, preferably in high-reliability or regulated environments (aerospace experience a plus).
 • Working knowledge of IPC standards (e.g., IPC-2221, IPC-7351, IPC-A-600) and their application in PCB design.
 • Experience applying high-speed PCB design principles, including differential pair routing, impedance control, and basic signal integrity considerations.
 • Proficiency with industry-standard ECAD tools, such as Altium Designer and/or Cadence Allegro/OrCAD.
 • Familiarity with rigid-flex and/or HDI PCB technologies.
 • Solid understanding of PCB fabrication and assembly processes, with the ability to support manufacturing handoffs and issue resolution.
 • Awareness of EMI/EMC design practices and electrostatic discharge (ESD) protection methods.
 • Ability to interpret electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, and manufacturing specifications.
 • Experience working within structured quality systems (e.g., AS9100 or ISO9001) preferred.
 • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional engineering teams.

 PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:
 • Sedentary Work- This role may require exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force frequently to lift carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects. Most essential functions are performed while sitting but walking and standing is required as needed.
 • Frequent use of hands and fingers to operate a computer, keyboard, and specialized design tools.
 • Visual acuity required to review detailed schematics, PCB layouts, and technical drawings on-screen and in print.
 • Ability to communicate effectively in person, via phone, and through virtual meetings.
 • Ability to access and navigate laboratory or production areas, including SMT manufacturing environments, when supporting builds or troubleshooting activities.

JOB DESCRIPTION:  

Summary:  

The Sanitation Manager provides strategic leadership for all sanitation operations across the facility, ensuring processing and packaging equipment and facilities consistently meet company, customer, regulatory, and food safety requirements. This role is responsible for managing, coaching, and developing the sanitation team, ensuring production readiness through effective sanitation practices, driving continuous improvement initiatives, optimizing labor and operating costs, and maintaining compliance through successful internal and external audits.  The Sanitation Manager will be supervising a team of 30 (27 sanitation employees, 2 leads, and 1 supervisor).
 
Essential Functions, Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Lead, coach, develop, and manage the Sanitation team to ensure a safe, engaged, and high-performing workforce.

  • Perform all other duties as assigned. 
Environmental, Health and Safety Requirements:

Food Safety:

job.title: Buyer
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a  Buyer to work at a company located in the Coral Gables, FL area!

Job Title: Buyer 
Job Location: Coral Gables 
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits:
$65K to $70K

Job Description
The Buyer is responsible for purchasing materials, components, equipment, and services required to support Gables Engineering’s avionics manufacturing and production operations.
This position works closely with Engineering, Production, Quality, Inventory, and Supply Chain teams to ensure materials are purchased at the appropriate cost, quality, and delivery schedule while maintaining compliance with aerospace quality standards and company purchasing procedures.

Key Responsibilities
  • Purchase electronic components, raw materials, hardware, mechanical parts, and manufacturing supplies used in avionics production.
  • Review purchase requisitions and issue purchase orders to approved suppliers.
  • Obtain and evaluate supplier quotations based on price, quality, availability, lead time, and delivery requirements.
  • Negotiate pricing, delivery schedules, minimum order quantities, and purchasing terms with vendors.
  • Monitor open purchase orders and follow up with suppliers regarding delivery status.
  • Expedite critical materials when necessary to prevent production delays.
  • Coordinate with Production Planning and Inventory teams to maintain adequate material availability.
  • Work closely with Engineering regarding specifications, drawings, bills of material, and component requirements.
  • Assist in identifying alternate suppliers and components when shortages or obsolescence issues occur.
  • Maintain accurate purchasing records, supplier documentation, pricing, delivery dates, and purchase-order information.
  • Resolve supplier issues involving late deliveries, shortages, damaged materials, incorrect parts, or quality concerns.
  • Coordinate with Quality and Incoming Inspection regarding rejected or nonconforming materials.
  • Process supplier returns and corrective-action requests when appropriate.
  • Review inventory levels and purchasing requirements to reduce excess inventory and material shortages.
  • Support cost-reduction and supplier-performance initiatives.
  • Maintain relationships with domestic and international suppliers.
  • Ensure purchasing activities comply with company quality procedures and applicable aerospace requirements.
  • Assist with supplier evaluations, approved-vendor documentation, and purchasing audits.
  • Communicate potential material shortages or supply-chain risks to management.
  • Support Engineering and Production with prototype, new-product, and special-project purchasing requirements.
Required Qualifications
  • High school diploma required; Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Business Administration, Operations, Procurement, or related field preferred.
  • 2–5 years of purchasing or buyer experience in a manufacturing environment.
  • Aerospace, avionics, electronics, defense, or precision manufacturing experience strongly preferred.
  • Experience purchasing electronic components, mechanical parts, raw materials, or production supplies.
  • Strong understanding of purchase orders, RFQs, supplier quotations, pricing, and lead times.
  • Strong negotiation and vendor-management skills.
  • Ability to read and understand part numbers, bills of material, engineering specifications, and purchasing documentation.
  • Strong organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and ERP/MRP systems.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience working within an AS9100 or ISO 9001 manufacturing environment.
  • Knowledge of aerospace purchasing and supplier-quality requirements.
  • Experience purchasing electronic components such as:
    • PCBs
    • Integrated circuits
    • Connectors
    • Switches
    • Displays
    • Wiring components
    • Hardware
    • Machined parts
  • Experience with ERP or MRP purchasing systems.
  • Knowledge of supplier qualification and approved-vendor processes.
  • Familiarity with material traceability, certificates of conformity, and aerospace documentation.
  • Experience managing component shortages and obsolete electronic parts.
Core Competencies
  • Purchasing & Procurement
  • Aerospace Manufacturing
  • Vendor Management
  • Supplier Negotiation
  • Purchase Orders
  • RFQs
  • Inventory Control
  • Material Planning
  • Electronic Components
  • ERP / MRP Systems
  • Cost Analysis
  • Supplier Performance
  • Quality Compliance
  • Production Support
  • Supply Chain Coordination
Position Objective
The Buyer supports Gables Engineering’s manufacturing operation by ensuring the correct materials and components are available on time, at the appropriate quality level, and at competitive cost, helping maintain production schedules and customer-delivery commitments.

job.title: CNC Machinists
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a CNC Machinist  to work at a company located in the Coral Gables, FL area!

Job Title: CNC Machinist 
 
Job Location: Coral Gables   
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: M-F $26-$27/hour T-P 8am – 5pm
 
Job Description:          
CNC Machinist – Aerospace Manufacturing
Reports To: Machine Shop Supervisor

Position Summary
We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented CNC Machinist to set up and operate CNC machinery used in the manufacturing of precision components for the aerospace and aviation industry.
The CNC Machinist will be responsible for producing components according to engineering specifications, maintaining tight tolerances, inspecting finished parts, and ensuring all work meets established quality and safety standards.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities
  • Set up and operate CNC mills, lathes, and other machining equipment.
  • Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, work instructions, and operation sheets.
  • Machine precision metal components according to dimensional and material specifications.
  • Install and align cutting tools, fixtures, attachments, and workpieces.
  • Perform machine setups, tool changes, offsets, and adjustments.
  • Adjust machine feeds, speeds, and controls as required.
  • Read and understand CNC machine code, including G-code.
  • Measure completed and in-process components using calipers, micrometers, gauges, and other precision measuring instruments.
  • Verify finished parts meet required tolerances and specifications.
  • Monitor machine operations for excessive vibration, worn tooling, dimensional variations, or equipment malfunctions.
  • Replace worn or damaged cutting tools when necessary.
  • Troubleshoot machining or production problems and make appropriate machine adjustments.
  • Collaborate with Engineering and Manufacturing teams to improve machining processes and CNC programs.
  • Maintain accurate production, inspection, and quality documentation.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe machine shop environment.
  • Follow established safety procedures and applicable aerospace quality requirements.
  • Perform additional machine shop duties as assigned.

Qualifications & Requirements
  • High School Diploma or GED required.
  • Minimum of 2 years of CNC machining or related machine shop experience preferred.
  • Experience operating CNC mills and/or CNC lathes.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, and dimensional specifications.
  • Knowledge of machining techniques, tooling applications, machine setups, feeds, speeds, and materials.
  • Ability to read and understand CNC programming code, including G-code.
  • Strong understanding of basic shop mathematics.
  • Experience using precision measuring instruments, including calipers, micrometers, and gauges.
  • Ability to perform machine setups and troubleshoot machining problems.
  • Basic computer proficiency.
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and commitment to producing high-quality precision components.

Preferred Experience
  • Previous experience in aerospace or aviation manufacturing.
  • Experience machining aluminum, stainless steel, and other aerospace-grade materials.
  • CNC setup and programming experience.
  • Familiarity with CAD/CAM manufacturing environments.
  • Experience working within AS9100, FAA, ISO, or other regulated aerospace quality environments.

Physical Requirements
  • Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
  • Frequent bending, reaching, and use of hands and arms.
  • Ability to lift and/or move approximately 40 pounds when required.
  • Ability to safely move materials using appropriate lifting equipment when necessary.

Job Description: 
A growing manufacturing operation is looking for experienced CNC and EDM Machine Operators to join its team. Candidates with strong machining experience, particularly Wire EDM or Sink EDM, are encouraged to apply.
Highly skilled operators may be considered for pay above the listed range based on experience and qualifications.

Bloomingdale, IL

Glendale Heights, IL

  • Set up and operate CNC, EDM, milling, grinding, or related machining equipment.

Interview Process
The first part of the interview will include a hands-on identification of common precision measuring tools. Candidates should be comfortable identifying:

  • Plug gauges

If you have recent CNC or EDM experience and are looking for an opportunity with competitive pay, apply today for immediate consideration.

job.title: Director of Trade Compliance
job.description:
The JobSquad Solutions Team is currently looking for a Director of Trade Compliance  to work at a company located in the Miami, FL area!

Job Title: Director of Trade Compliance 
 
Job Location: Miami, FL 33172
 
Pay and Hours for Job + Benefits: $140K per year 
 
Job Description: 
 
Director of Trade Compliance is responsible for leading and overseeing global trade compliance program, ensuring adherence to all applicable import and export regulations. This role partners closely with internal leadership, the Trade Compliance Manager (TCM), and third-party customs brokers to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant international trade operations.
 
The Director will drive strategic compliance initiatives, mitigate regulatory risks, optimize duty exposure, and ensure the organization operates in full compliance with U.S. and international trade laws, including EAR, OFAC, and BIS requirements.
 
Key accountabilities:
 
  • Develop, implement, and continuously enhance company’s global trade compliance program.
  • Establish policies, procedures, and internal controls to ensure compliance with U.S., UK/EU, and international trade regulations.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert on export controls, including EAR, OFAC sanctions, and BIS regulations.
  • Provide strategic guidance to executive leadership on trade compliance risks, mitigation strategies, and business impacts.
  • Oversee classification management, including HS, HTS, Schedule B, and ECCN for all part numbers within the master database.
  • Ensure proper documentation, valuation, and country-of-origin determinations for all imports.
  • Provide clear instructions to freight forwarders and customs brokers to ensure smooth customs clearance.
  • Lead export compliance activities, including licensing determinations, screening, and documentation requirements.
  • Conduct end-use and end-user reviews to ensure compliance with export control regulations.
  • Assess transshipment and diversion risks and implement controls to mitigate exposure.
  • Lead internal audits, investigations, and compliance assessments.
  • Monitor and interpret regulatory changes and ensure timely implementation across the organization.
  • Identify and implement strategies to minimize duty and tax exposure.
  • Collaborate with Finance and Operations to optimize unit pricing structures and duty savings opportunities.
  • Manage duty relief programs, including drawback and other applicable mechanisms.
  • Develop and deliver trade compliance training programs for relevant internal stakeholders.
  • Promote a culture of compliance and accountability across all business units.
  • Maintain up-to-date documentation of policies, procedures, and regulatory guidance.
  • Partner with the Trade Compliance Manager and manage relationships with third-party customs brokers and logistics providers.
  • Support high-volume inbound and outbound shipment activities with a focus on accuracy and timeliness.
  • Provide expert guidance in escalated or complex compliance matters, exercising sound, risk-based decision making.
Experience and qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred (or equivalent experience); advanced certifications in trade compliance are a plus
  • Minimum of 5+ years of experience in trade compliance, with progressive responsibility (10+ preferred for director level)
     Strong expertise in:
  • EAR (Export Administration Regulations)
  • OFAC sanctions compliance
  • BIS regulations and enforcement
  • End-use and end-user screening
  • Transshipment and diversion risk analysis
  • Extensive knowledge of:
  • ITAR and U.S. import/export regulations
  • UK/EU import requirements
  • Tariff classification, customs valuation, and country of origin rules
  • INCOTERMs and international logistics processes
  • Proven experience managing customs brokers and third-party logistics providers
  • Experience in the aviation industry strongly preferred
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • High degree of professionalism, integrity, and sound judgment
  • Proven experience with duty relief management, tariff classification, customs valuation and customs origins

job.description:

Job Description:                                                          
 
 
 
EXPERIENCE REQUIRED -  Daily Duties & Responsibilities
  • Pre-Trip Inspections: Check truck fluids, tires, brakes, vacuum pumps, and secure all hoses and valves. 
  • Site Preparation: Locate underground tanks, dig to expose access lids using tools like a rock bar or soil probe, and manage physical labor on site. 
  • Waste Extraction: Hook up suction hoses, operate vacuum pump systems, and carefully monitor waste flow to prevent spills. 
  • Transportation & Disposal: Drive loaded tanker waste securely to an approved municipal or regional treatment facility. 
  • Customer Service: Answer client questions regarding the pumping process and note any structural damage or failing components inside the septic system. 
Equipment Maintenance Checklist
  • Daily Checks: Inspect suction hoses for cracks, soft spots, or loose clamps; test valves for smooth operation.
  • Weekly Tasks: Clear debris from tank baffles, clean sludge buildup, and inspect the primary shut-off float and manway gaskets.
  • Monthly & Routine Servicing: Check fluid levels, grease PTO shafts, inspect vacuum pump performance, and test vehicle battery terminals for corrosion.
 
Requirements
  • Reasonable Driving Background: CDL Preferred, not required. 
  • Physical Stamina: Ability to lift heavy items (frequently over 50 to 150 lbs) and work outdoors in varied weather conditions.
  • Safety & Compliance: Strict adherence to Department of Transportation (DOT) and environmental waste disposal guidelines. 
 
 
90 days will move to permanent employee, and become eligible for medical, dental, vision, and 401k program.
